-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #120 / Scene #1 - Function Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent
function Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town001D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10008, 663.00, 755.00, 54, 2, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 1478, 681.00, 751.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(2, 1479, 677.00, 759.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 1, 10)
	CreateObject(3, 1480, 672.00, 753.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(4, 1481, 672.00, 744.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)
	CreateObject(5, 10002, 737.00, 733.00, 182, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM037.ogg")
	PlayCameraNoWait("Phin_Senerep_Talk_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(2000)
	OpenTalkScene(13, 1)
	AniObject(0, 1, 1)
	PlayCameraNoWait("Phin_Senerep_Talk_02.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(1500)
	OpenTalkScene(13, 2)
	PlayMusic("BGM038.ogg")
	WalkObject(0, 693.000000, 885.000000, 76.339996, 1, 51, 1)
	WalkObject(5, 690.000000, 744.000000, 76.339996, 1, 51, 0)
	RotateObject(1, 54, 1)
	RotateObject(2, 54, 1)
	RotateObject(3, 54, 1)
	RotateObject(4, 54, 1)
	wait(2000)
	AniObject(5, 1, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(13, 3)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Phindous_Senerep_TalkEvent)
